query: INSERT INTO live_variant_health (source_id, variant_key, last_success_at, last_failure_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(source_id, variant_key) DO UPDATE SET last_success_at = COALESCE(excluded.last_success_at, last_success_at), last_failure_at = COALESCE(excluded.last_failure_at, last_failure_at)
